projects.title: Udhyog Saathi
projects.subtitle: SaaS Product (Business Operating System)
highlights: Designed a SaaS-based Business Operating System for MSMEs to centralize billing, inventory, and workforce management into a single platform.
Defined and structured end-to-end business workflows (billing, stock tracking, worker management), improving process clarity and reducing manual dependency.
Developed system architecture and dashboards to provide real-time visibility into operations, enabling data-driven decision making.
Identified operational bottlenecks and proposed automation workflows (event-based triggers, WhatsApp integration) to improve efficiency and scalability.

projects.title: HotReload
projects.subtitle: Developer Tool (CLI)
highlights: Created a CLI tool in Go that automates server rebuilds and restarts on file changes, eliminating manual stop/rebuild steps and accelerating development feedback loops.
Implemented recursive file watching with fsnotify, debouncing to handle rapid events, and process management for graceful server restarts; supports multiple project types with auto-detection.
Designed modular architecture with separate packages for watching, building, running, and project detection, ensuring maintainability and extensibility.

highlights.label: Technologies Used
highlights.text: Go, fsnotify, CLI design, process lifecycle management.

projects.title: InsightLoop

Integrated WebSockets for live data synchronization and an AI assistant to streamline operations and improve decision-making.

public_profile.introduction: I’m Krishna Goyal, a product-minded frontend and full-stack engineer interested in turning real-world problems into practical software.
public_profile.approach: I like to understand the goal and the people using a product before choosing how to build it. From there, I focus on useful interfaces, considered backend and API work, and practical scope that can be maintained and improved.
public_profile.focus: My interests include SaaS products, business workflows, developer tools, dashboards, and automation.
